name: Design to Code
description: Implement UI from design mockups (Figma, Sketch, or screenshots) with pixel-accurate layout, checking spacing, type scale, colour values, and interaction against the source item by item. First determines whether a link, a screenshot, or only a description was supplied, then reads the existing stack and components before writing code. Use this skill whenever the request mentions a mockup, pixel-accurate implementation, slicing, or building to a supplied design.
